verdict.rationale: There is a confirmed live llms.txt at developer.mastercard.com (HTTP 200) plus an official agent-oriented MCP toolkit doc explicitly describing AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf) querying Mastercard docs contextually, showing a real agent-facing entry point beyond generic docs. Missing for 10: no evidence llms.txt is scoped specifically to Open Finance product docs (it's platform-wide), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of agent success using it.
